newest.description: Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon for Trusted Cyber Defenders. Google just released a powerful new AI model for cyber defense, but it’s restricted to a select few. We’re breaking down what this means for your security and the future of AI-driven protection. What we covered: • Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon for Trusted Cyber Defenders • DeepMind Introduces SynthID Bio to Watermark Synthetic Proteins • DoorDash Launches Text-Based AI Ordering Agent Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: Would you trust an AI agent to order your 'usual' groceries via text without your final review? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed.
